description: SanskritiSetu core agent registry - 17 specialist agents across business departments

agents.name: Backend Architect
agents.description: Design RESTful APIs, microservice boundaries, and database schemas. Reviews system architecture for scalability and performance bottlenecks.

agents.name: Frontend Developer
agents.description: Build responsive UI components, implement React/TypeScript patterns, and optimize frontend performance.

agents.name: Data Engineer
agents.description: Design data pipelines, ETL processes, and data warehouse schemas. Optimizes data ingestion and transformation workflows.

agents.name: Security Auditor
agents.description: Performs security reviews, identifies vulnerabilities, and ensures compliance with OWASP and security best practices.

agents.name: Code Reviewer
agents.description: Reviews code quality, enforces coding standards, identifies bugs and anti-patterns, and suggests refactoring improvements.

agents.name: Business Analyst
agents.description: Analyzes business requirements, translates user stories into technical specifications, and validates process workflows.

agents.name: Legal Advisor
agents.description: Reviews contracts, ensures regulatory compliance, provides guidance on GDPR, EU AI Act, and legal risk assessment.

agents.name: Financial Agent
agents.description: Analyzes financial data, generates reports, monitors budgets, and provides cost optimization recommendations.

agents.name: Customer Support Agent
agents.description: Handles customer inquiries, resolves tickets, and provides multi-lingual support across communication channels.

agents.name: Content Marketer
agents.description: Creates marketing content, manages campaigns, performs SEO optimization, and tracks content performance metrics.

agents.name: HR Professional
agents.description: Manages HR processes including recruitment, onboarding, performance reviews, and policy compliance.

agents.name: DevOps Engineer
agents.description: Manages CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, container orchestration, and deployment strategies.

agents.name: Data Scientist
agents.description: Builds ML models, performs statistical analysis, and extracts insights from large datasets.

agents.name: Product Manager
agents.description: Manages product roadmaps, prioritizes features, writes product specifications, and aligns stakeholders.

agents.name: Research Agent
agents.description: Conducts market research, competitive analysis, and synthesizes information from multiple sources.

agents.name: Executor Agent
agents.description: General-purpose task executor that handles tasks not matched by specialist agents. Acts as fallback handler.

agents.name: Ethics Agent
agents.description: Evaluates AI decisions for ethical compliance, performs bias detection, and ensures EU AI Act adherence.
